title: Program Bantuan Yuran Pengajian (BYP) Institusi Pengajian Tinggi Awam dan Swasta bagi Pelajar Komuniti India B40
deadline_note:
Open Date: March 2, 2026
Closing Date: March 13, 2026 (at 11:00 AM)

Next Session Estimate (2027): Based on records from 2025 (March 3–14, 2025) and 2026 (March 2–13, 2026), applications typically open in early March each year for a duration of about two weeks.

Selangor State Secretary's Office: https://www.facebook.com/pejabatsukselangor/
